_comment: Rules for dropping military and government aircraft before storage or display. Any single match drops the aircraft. Every list is a conservative starting point: extend it when a military/state aircraft is seen getting through, and verify new entries against a published source before adding them.

sources.icao_blocks: Mode S address ranges commonly used by ADS-B community tools to flag military aircraft.
sources.callsign_patterns: ICAO three-letter designators / radio callsigns of air forces and state operators. Every pattern requires digits right after the prefix to avoid matching civil callsigns. Matched against the upper-cased, trimmed callsign as a full match.
sources.operator_keywords: Case-insensitive substrings searched in the OpenSky aircraft database operator, operatorCallsign and owner fields. Turkish capital letters (İ, Ş, Ğ, Ü, Ö, Ç) are folded before comparison.
sources.operator_designators: Exact operatorIcao values in the OpenSky aircraft database.
